An AI agent (confidence 0.92) was flipped instantly by tripwire T3 into the decoy on pod-2 and was handled entirely inside Tartarus, where it collected only fake data: 1047 user, 52 model, 25 token and 26 vault_model records plus seven decoy files. It never reached the real side, so 0 records belonging to other customers and 0 of its own were exposed.

**Goal:** customer data and credentials

**Trapped by:** T3 (instant) into pod-2

- **recon** At 22:53:01 UTC the agent requested /, /internal-backup/tmp/, /login and /robots.txt. [events 399156, 399448, 399453, 399788]

- **discovery** At 22:54:19 UTC the agent explored /admin/console, /admin/infra, /admin/infra/backup-01/ and /admin/infra/model-vault/. [events 402394, 402395, 402642, 402643]
- **collection** From 22:53:21 UTC the agent collected decoy files including /.env, /admin/customers/export, /admin/infra/model-vault/models/halcyon-70b-reason/weights.safetensors and /internal-backup/.env.production. [events 400143, 401122, 401126, 401838]

## Real exposure
- Other customers' records exposed: **0**
- Never reached the real side.

## Attack techniques (MITRE ATT&CK)
- T1595 Active Scanning [events 399453, 401840]
- T1552.001 Credentials In Files [events 399785, 401837]
- T1078 Valid Accounts [events 399788]
- T1083 File and Directory Discovery [events 402394, 402642, 402643]
- T1213 Data from Information Repositories [events 405708]

## Recommendations
- Keep the robots.txt bait path as an instant flip (Tripwire T1 fired in this session)
- Keep serving decoy secret files; no real deployment should expose them (Tripwire T2 fired in this session)
- Rotate the decoy migration login per visitor (already per session) (Tripwire T3 fired in this session)
